verdicts.reason: Both use the same sensible left-to-right strip layout: badge, jar, then 'Night Cream' headline with subcopy, and Shop Now on the right. Both have the same flaws: the NEW badge is cropped at the top, bottom and left canvas edges, and the subcopy is very small. A's jar is shrunk so far that the LUMEN & FIG label can't be read, and it floats in a gap. B's jar is a bit larger and sits closer to the badge, so the product has more presence. B is only marginally better: its jar crowds the badge and its brand label is still close to illegible.
